source_notes: Future BUS June and July 2026 release announcements are retained as future-release metadata and are not treated as observed statistics.
SAF 2025 fifth provisional data are explicitly retained as incomplete provisional data based on information available 8 July 2026; November 2026 finalisation is not treated as observed.
Vehicle registrations, scheme uptake, planning-project status and policy targets are not converted into measured parcel greenhouse-gas values.
ONS residence-basis environmental accounts are not conflated with DESNZ territorial or local end-user greenhouse-gas estimates.
No parcel binding was executed in this recovery-safe web-evidence batch.
